newsitem.title: USA: Barringer files for 2mln shr public offer.
newsitem.headline: Barringer files for 2mln shr public offer.

text.p: Barringer Technologies Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement for a public offering of two million shares with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Based on Barringer's stock price of $15.375 Friday morning, the company could raise as much as $30.8 milion in the offering.
The manufacturer of drug and explosives detecting equipment said it intended to use the proceeds to increase marketing, expand facilities and pursue acquisitions.
Barringer, which currently has 5.4 million shares outstanding, said Robertson Stephens & Co LLC and Pacific Growth Equities Inc will manage the offering.
